profile.headline: Senior DevOps Engineer at Akamai Technologies
profile.summary:
Software Development in C/C++ on unix. Strong skill debugging C/C++ applications on Unix OS's (AIX, Solaris, HPUX, Linux) strong knowledge using dbx, gdb and adb debugger on unix, as well on windows platforms (msdev, windbg).

Specialties: Software Editor for Messaging and Collaboration systems.

Test Automation Framework Architect, Shift Left Continuous Testing passionate.
DevOps Software Engineer, working with Chef, Ruby, Git, Jenkins, UrbanCode Deploy, Rational Tools, Python, bash.

positions.title: DevOps Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer of the Akamai Platform Engineering team to help evolve the Akamai private cloud infrastructure and services.
My team is in charge of developing global managed services for use by internal teams for economically deploying highly scalable products. 
Currently working and leveraging technologies such as the open source project Vault from Hashicorp, containers, Kubernetes orchestration on Istio.
Strong knowledge on all linux internals and system calls, working daily on creating automation tools using Python, using terraform/ansible as configuration manager tools.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer at IBM
positions.description:
Working on the new IBM Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) product.
Responsible for monitoring, performance and availability of the networking systems of IBM Cloud.
Software-Defined Networking (SDN) experience.
Working in a Cloud Platform using Kubernetes, Docker containers, Prometheus, Kibana, Grafana.

positions.title: DevOps Senior Software Engineer - IBM Watson Health
positions.description:
DevOps Software Engineer at IBM Watson Health, working on the CICD Deployment Pipeline for all the components/services of the Watson Health solutions.
Design and build advanced automated build, test and release infrastructure.
Designed and developed from scratch an automation test framework for Watson Health Platform for FVT, IVT, DryRun testing using Java and Cucumber technology.
Test Automation Framework Architect, Shift Left Continuous Testing passionate.
Strong knowledge of the most advanced technologies in the CICD environments, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, IBM Urban Code Deploy, UCDP, Rational Quality Manager, Chef.
Java, Ruby, C/C++ development languages.
Strong knowledge of linux and most unixes flavors.

positions.title: DevOps Software Engineer - SmartCloud Verse
positions.description:
DevOps Software Engineer at the SmartCloud Notes Verse Team, working with Chef, Ruby, Git, RTC, CI/CD, Jenkins, Linux shell scripting. Platform of Development is Linux RedHat. Production Data Center are in SoftLayer.
Main project: design/develop/test/deploy the CICD component responsible to deliver the SCN artifacts to the Testing and Production environments, unix daemon developed in Ruby.

positions.title: Unix Software Engineer
positions.description: Working at the Lotus Support Organization in France as Software Engineer. Supporting lotus notes/domino running on all the unix supported platforms, solaris, aix, hpux and linux.

positions.title: Unix Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working at the Software Development Labs of the company, making Railways Command/Control systems to supervise the Italian Railways System. Partecipating in all the phases of the project, analysis/design/development/testing. Software Development on Unix using C/C++, mainly in the network layer and some X-Window skill.

Projects I partecipated:

- Analysis and Development of a National system for the Traffic Railway Regulation in Italy.
- Analysis and Development of a unified system for the local control of Railway Traffic.
- Analysis and Development of Railway Centralized Traffic Control.
- Analysis and Development of the Central Site of Supervision System of the Line 3 underground Milano.
- Analysis and Development of the Central Site of Supervision System of Line underground Budapest BKV.
- Some studies of Intranet network, setup of the firewall for the connection to the Internet.
